q: How do I discuss a growth project with Shobon?
a: Use the contact form or email younusshobon@gmail.com. Share your website, target customers and the business challenge you want to address.

q: What information should I include in my enquiry?
a: Your website, audience, priority product or service, current challenge and what you have already tried help us have a useful first conversation.

q: Can I ask for a technical SEO audit?
a: Yes. Mention the platform, site size and any known indexing, speed or migration issue so the audit scope can be discussed.

q: Can we start with keyword research only?
a: Yes. A focused keyword and search-intent project can help decide which pages to build or improve before committing to broader SEO work.

q: Do you work with businesses outside Dubai?
a: Yes. I'm based in Dubai and work with businesses across the Gulf, US and UK remotely, with calls scheduled around time zones.

q: Will you need access to my website immediately?
a: No. A first conversation can begin with the public website and your goals. Search Console, analytics or CMS access can be agreed later if needed.

q: Can you promise a specific increase in leads?
a: A specific lead increase cannot be promised. We agree a baseline, define a qualified enquiry and review progress alongside your market conditions, sales feedback and implementation pace.

q: Can I reach you on WhatsApp?
a: Yes. The footer links to WhatsApp at +880 1309 580863. Email is also available if you prefer to describe the project in detail.
